opportunities.title: 85726B0066-2600055- FORKLIFTS ELECTRIC
opportunities.summary: The City is seeking competitive sealed bids for a 5‑year contract to supply electric forklifts. This solicitation is for procurement of equipment, not services, and therefore does not align with an immigration legal services provider. No specific certifications or eligibility requirements are mentioned in the notice.

opportunities.title: 07126B0002-DHS SPECIFIC CSB
opportunities.summary: The solicitation seeks an on‑call vendor to provide travel reservation and ticketing services for the NYC Department of Homeless Services. The work involves booking transportation and issuing tickets on an as‑needed basis. This is a travel services contract, not an immigration legal services engagement.

opportunities.title: SMD_A&CM_RFQ #521210
opportunities.summary: The NYC Housing Authority is seeking qualified design‑build teams to renovate in‑unit units across multiple NYCHA buildings, covering plumbing, kitchen/bathroom repairs, heat‑pump and electrical upgrades, flood mitigation, elevator modernization, and hazardous material abatement with possible temporary resident relocation. This is a construction‑focused procurement, not an immigration legal services engagement, so it does not align with an immigration legal provider’s scope. The RFQ is the first step to qualify for a later RFP on these projects.

opportunities.title: FY27 Renewal - FJC Immigration Legal Center
opportunities.agency: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
opportunities.vendor: New York Legal Assistance Group Inc.
opportunities.summary: The Department of Social Services/HR Administration is renewing a contract to provide core civil legal services at the five New York City Family Justice Centers. The services focus on immigration‑related legal assistance—including applications, representation before agencies and courts, and support for self‑representing clients—for survivors of domestic and gender‑based violence and their children.

opportunities.title: INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY AND TELECOMMUNICATIONS INFRASTRUCTURE  INTENT TO AWARD CHICAGO SOFT
opportunities.summary: The NYC Department of Information Technology & Telecommunications is awarding a contract for maintenance of proprietary Chicago Soft software. Vendors must submit a response through PASSPort by July 24, 2026. This IT software maintenance work does not align with immigration legal services.

opportunities.title: In-Person/VRI interpretation for Spoken Languages Services
opportunities.summary: The Administration for Children’s Services (ACS) is awarding contracts to three vendors to provide in‑person and video remote interpreting for spoken languages, Deaf/Hard‑of‑Hearing interpreting, language services, and written translation. The services will support ACS and its provider network in serving limited‑English proficient and deaf/hard‑of‑hearing families. Contracts will be awarded through a competitive sealed‑proposal solicitation for a term of July 1 2026 through June 30 2029.

opportunities.title: Deaf/Hard-of-Hearing Language Access Services
opportunities.summary: The Administration for Children’s Services (ACS) is awarding a contract via competitive sealed proposals for sign language interpretation services, including in‑person, on‑site, and on‑demand video remote interpretation. The services cover American Sign Language, Certified Deaf Interpretation, foreign sign languages, and Communication Access Realtime Translation to support ACS and its provider network in serving limited‑English proficient and deaf/hard‑of‑hearing families. The contract term is July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2029.

opportunities.title: Translation Services
opportunities.summary: The Administration for Children’s Services (ACS) is procuring three vendors to provide in‑person and video remote interpretation for spoken languages, deaf/hard‑of‑hearing interpretation, and written translation services. These services will support ACS and its network of providers in serving limited‑English proficient and deaf/hard‑of‑hearing families to ensure compliance with applicable local, state, and federal accessibility laws. The contracts will be awarded via Competitive Sealed Proposals for a term from July 1 2026 to June 30 2029.

opportunities.title: SECURE DETENTION SURVEILLANCE SYSTEM INSTALLATION AND MAINTENANCE
opportunities.summary: The award is for the installation and ongoing maintenance of a secure detention surveillance system, issued as a non‑competitive small purchase to a qualified M/WBE vendor. This work involves security hardware and services, not immigration legal services, so it does not align with the firm’s immigration legal service capabilities.
certifications_required: Prequalification application with compliance to annual corporate filing requirements

opportunities.title: FY27 Renewal - NYCitizenship Program
opportunities.agency: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
opportunities.vendor: New York Legal Assistance Group Inc.
opportunities.summary: The agency is procuring free legal screenings and services to guide participants of the NYCitizenship Program through the naturalization process, aiming to improve their eligibility for benefits. This work is being awarded through a renewal contract under the Human Services/Client Services category.

opportunities.title: Outside Land Use & Zoning Counsel with respect to the Science Park & Research Campus (SPARC) Kips Bay Project
opportunities.address: One Liberty Plaza, 165 Broadway, 14th Floor Mailroom, New York, NY 10006
opportunities.summary: NYCEDC is seeking proposals from law firms or individual lawyers to provide outside legal counsel for analysis, drafting, and review of applications for tax lot apportionments and zoning lot subdivisions related to Manhattan Tax Block 962, part of Lot 100, for the Science Park & Research Campus (SPARC) Kips Bay development. The services will support NYCEDC’s preparation of new building permit filings and related zoning matters, and will be awarded through a Request for Proposals process.

opportunities.title: American Sign Language (ASL) Interpretation
opportunities.address: 100 Church Street, 12th Floor, New York, NY 10007
opportunities.summary: The Campaign Finance Board will award a negotiated acquisition contract to LC Interpreting Services LLC (doing business as SignNexus) for American Sign Language (ASL) interpretation services. The contract is capped at $99,999 and will run from August 1, 2025 through July 31, 2027.
